newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Invicta acquires CSE Equipment.
newsitem.headline: Invicta acquires CSE Equipment.

text.p: Invicta Holdings Ltd announced on Tuesday that it had acquired the entire shareholding of CSE Equipment Co (Pty) Ltd and its associated companies, with effect from July 1, 1996.
CSE is the exclusive distributor of CASE Corp machinery in South Africa. CASE is one of the world's largest manufacturers of agricultural and construction equipment.

The purchase consideration is 19.4 million rand, which has been satisfied by way of 15.6 million rand in cash and the issue and allotment in August 1996 of 1.2 million ordinary shares in Invicta at an issue price of 300 cents per share.
